For the questions with versions,
Bluebook has directions about which
version to answer. The corresponding
free-response booklet page number
for each question will also be listed in
Bluebook.

AP Physics (all four subjects) continued
For the questions with versions,
students must write on the correct
corresponding page based on which
version of the question—J, K, L, or M—
they see indicated in Bluebook.
Some questions have graphics
printed in the booklet. These
sample pages indicate where the
graphics might appear.
